messages:
olivia: Heads up — staging engineers without deploy.canary were able to flip gradual-release flags this morning. Saw 3 unexpected toggles at 09:12 UTC.

samir: omg. do we have an audit trail? can you paste the log lines?

olivia: logs:
```
[2026-03-18T09:12:21Z] user=eng_junior action=feature_flag.toggle flag=gradual_release_42 result=success via=console role_assertion=allowed source=staging
[2026-03-18T09:12:22Z] user=eng_junior action=feature_flag.toggle flag=gradual_release_42 result=success via=console role_assertion=allowed source=staging
[2026-03-18T09:12:24Z] user=eng_junior action=feature_flag.toggle flag=gradual_release_42 result=success via=console role_assertion=allowed source=staging
```

alice.k: looks like the authz check skipped the `deploy.rollout` gate and accepted `console.feature_toggle` as sufficient — probably after the RBAC refactor last week.

devon: i pushed the RBAC change (PR#2345) that combined rollout and toggle perms into a single scope. might be the regression. rolling back now.

olivia: please mark P1 and preserve audit logs — we need copies for triage. do not delete any KMS-wrapped logs.

samir: agree. instead of removing KMS, export snapshots (read-only) to a secure bucket and grant sec-oncall decrypt access. infra, can you help? @infra-bot?

infra-bot: Created incident INC-2026-042 assigned to @devon and @alice.k. Preserving raw audit bundle at gs://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-042/audit.tgz (kms: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/incident/cryptoKeys/retain).

devon: rolling back PR now. will push revert in ~8m and run a small smoke matrix for rollouts + flags.

alice.k: after revert we should add an explicit deny rule: any `feature_flag.toggle` that targets `gradual_release_*` requires `deploy.rollout` role claim. also add an integration test hitting `/api/v1/flags/toggle`.

samir: also propose adding an HSM-backed signing step for rollout actions (KMS sign) — prevents console-only spoofing if UI role checks are bypassed. low-lift and audit-friendly.

olivia: tagging legal/compliance for potential customer impact. please capture timeline of toggles and any correlated traffic.

compliance-bot: Notified #compliance. Incident metadata recorded: INC-2026-042.

olivia: tl;dr: RBAC refactor regressed rollout gating; staging devs could toggle gradual releases. rollback+audit export in progress, follow-up PR to add explicit perms + KMS-backed signature for rollouts. will update INC ticket with timeline and impact.

samir: thanks — when revert is merged ping this thread and add the postmortem stub to /docs/postmortems/inc-2026-042.md

devon: revert merged. smoke tests green. pushing follow-up PR with explicit deny and tests now (PR#2378).

olivia: great. leaving this open until PR#2378 is deployed to prod and audit validates no more unexpected toggles. :thumbsup:
